description: Flat half-circle khaprail tile, a fish-scale style clay roofing tile made by Pak Clay in Lahore. The rounded lower edge gives the roof a soft scalloped pattern that suits villas, farmhouses and decorative roof sections. Clay is a traditional roofing material known for its long life and natural colour that does not need repainting. Ask for a free sample on WhatsApp to see the finish and size in your hands, and tell us your roof area for a written quote.

Flat rectangular khaprail tile in natural fired clay, made by Pak Clay in Lahore since 1982. The flat profile gives a clean, modern roofline and suits both new builds and restoration work. Clay roofing is valued for its durability and comfortable indoor temperatures. Request a free sample on WhatsApp, and send your roof area and city for a written, dated quote.

French-profile khaprail tile with a green glaze, made by Pak Clay in Lahore. The glaze adds lasting colour to the clay surface and works well on villas, boundary walls and feature roofs where a coloured finish is wanted. The interlocking French profile is designed to channel rain off the roof. Get a free sample on WhatsApp to check the glaze colour in daylight, and ask for a quote for your roof area.

French-profile khaprail tile in natural red clay, made by Pak Clay in Lahore. The profile channels rainwater along its ridges and gives the roof a classic tiled look in the warm red of fired clay. It suits houses, villas and commercial roofs where a traditional appearance is wanted. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your roof area for a written quote.
